data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (From/To, date, Passengers/Class, Confirm, Show flights, select fare per leg) and parameterizes passengers and cabin, but it adds a Stopover booking type and a Continue click, and it lists cabin as only Economy or Premium. It also leaves out which flight price to click, which is still workable for automation.
